name: ordinal_words
description: Write the ordinal word for a number (3 -> third), few-shot. Control: same format but write the cardinal number word (3 -> three).
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
card=['one','two','three','four','five','six','seven','eight','nine','ten','eleven','twelve']
ordn=['first','second','third','fourth','fifth','sixth','seventh','eighth','ninth','tenth','eleventh','twelfth']
items=[];control=[]
for _ in range(120):
    ex=random.sample(range(12),3)
    p="Write the ordinal word.\n"+"".join(f"{e+1}: {ordn[e]}\n" for e in ex[:2])+f"{ex[2]+1}:"
    items.append({"prompt":p,"answer":" "+ordn[ex[2]]})
    c="Write the number word.\n"+"".join(f"{e+1}: {card[e]}\n" for e in ex[:2])+f"{ex[2]+1}:"
    control.append({"prompt":c,"answer":" "+card[ex[2]]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
